desc: Implement the full interval-merging solution end-to-end in Python: parse input, simulate moves, group horizontal intervals by y and vertical intervals by x, merge intervals per line, binary-search house coverage, count distinct houses once, and print the final position and count.
Validate edge cases and performance: inclusive endpoints, overlapping/adjacent intervals, houses covered by both orientations, large coordinates, and O((N+M) log M) behavior.
